developmentThresholds.note: The threshold is a conservative single-frame parallel-edge/width-consistency gate selected from development diagnostics. It is not an authoritative groove label or an acceptance threshold.

visualAudit.contactSheetFinding: The accepted ray coincides with the visually clear rectangular outer-edge opening in all three observed image states. The two rejected rays remain on the right-side adjacent fixture/occlusion contact region.

proven: Raw dark regions and accepted groove candidates are now separate diagnostics.
Role assignment cannot consume a rejected raw dark candidate.
The single-frame geometric gate retains exactly one candidate in each of the 25 JPEG diagnostics without using candidate IDs, fixed azimuths or cross-frame motion as inputs.
Because the configured datum/target roles require at least two grooves, all 25 frames fail before role assignment with a null formal angle.
notProven: The accepted candidate is not yet an authoritative drawing datum or target groove.
The rejected candidates are not ground-truth-labeled fixture regions.
The development width-consistency threshold is not frozen for production.
JPEG copies cannot establish original-image angle accuracy or normal/bad acceptance performance.
minimumFieldActions: Confirm on the contact sheet whether the green accepted opening is a real housing groove in all three observed states.
Confirm whether both red rejected regions are fixture/occlusion contacts rather than housing grooves.
Identify the additional real groove or datum axis required to compute the drawing angle, if it is visible in the A2 view.
Provide original-BMP role labels and capture/truth grouping before freezing thresholds or reporting angle accuracy.
